app.title: Launch HN: Axonnic (YC F26) – Sleeves that track fingers and estimate force
app.description: Axonnic sleeves are wearable sensors that track finger movements and estimate applied force using embedded IMUs and pressure sensors.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run example calibration script
Connect a sleeve to the SDK, measure latency of force estimation
Upload sample data to web dashboard and verify real-time visualization
Compare sensor accuracy against a known force gauge
